title: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker and former Avacynian priest who protects Kessig villages and investigates new, larger werewolves as Innistrad's sun dims.

entities.name: Klaus
entities.description: A two-hundred-year-old Falkenrath vampire who sells false talismans to villagers and is killed by werewolf hunters.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A Kessig widow whose husband Finneas was killed the previous night and who tells Arlinn about the witch.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: Agatha's late husband, who followed secret signs to the witches' enclave.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A towering white-haired witch who leads the Dawnhart Coven and wants to hold a Harvesttide ritual at the Celestus.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf whose howl Arlinn recognizes and who once left her a message with a stag's skull.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: The fastest wolf in Arlinn's pack, named for the white line on his flank.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: Streak's mate and an alert wolf of Arlinn's pack.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: A wolf of Arlinn's pack who once waited outside the cathedral doors for her.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: The largest and friendliest wolf of Arlinn's pack.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: A coven of witches who say they are what was once and will be, now coming back into the light.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline known for stubborn, ravenous hunting.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel whose protection fell during the Travails and whose symbol still hangs in Kessig homes.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: A catastrophe when Avacyn fell and wolfir overran the woods.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Massive ancient stone arches in the Kessig woods with a central platform and a lock of bright gold, once used to balance day and night.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key needed to activate the Celestus.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: A traditional humans' celebration of living another year in defiance, which Katilda wants to revive as a ritual.

entities.name: Candleguides
entities.description: Wax-faced scarecrow guides born of village anxieties, which float in the witches' enclave.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The wooded region where the story is set.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: The forest where Klaus is hunted.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Arlinn's home plane, where nights grow longer.

events.summary: Klaus, a Falkenrath vampire, runs through the Ulvenwald from a pack of hunters, grinning.
events.quote: His feet slap against the brush; blood drips from his slick chin onto the reddening leaves of the Ulvenwald

events.summary: At dusk Klaus drops his glamour and turns into a monstrous form to terrify the hunters.
events.quote: Already he can feel it, his body straining beneath the glamour, his teeth growing longer and sharper.

events.summary: The hunters shift into towering werewolves in the moonlight.
events.quote: their bodies exploding from their fleshy constraints into their real forms: towering beasts

events.summary: The werewolf leader tells Klaus the rhyme only applies to humans.
The werewolves kill Klaus as he leaps from the branch.
Arlinn walks through a frozen Kessig village, noting that sundown comes sooner and sooner.
Arlinn sits with Agatha, whose husband was killed, and promises to investigate the murders.
events.quote: even now as she tells his wife that she'll do her best to investigate these murders

events.summary: Agatha tells Arlinn that a witch is making effigies to help the village.
Arlinn recalls sparing a white stag and finding a skull left by Tovolar the next morning (flashback).
events.quote: there was a skull before them, resting atop a sword driven into the ground

events.summary: Arlinn's wolves lead her along carved boughs toward the witches' enclave.
events.quote: A series of crescents and rounds line it, shaped by a careful hand.

events.summary: Arlinn meets a false white stag and realizes it is a trick by Katilda.
events.quote: a stag, pure white, beneath a branch festooned with carved silver

events.summary: Arlinn finds the witches' enclave beneath an arch of the Celestus.
events.quote: she now sees an enclave: branches and hides fashioned into tents

events.summary: Katilda declares her people the Dawnhart Coven.
Arlinn names herself and says she wants answers before the dawn is gone.
Katilda explains the plan: return to Harvesttide traditions and gather people beneath the Celestus to restore the balance.
events.quote: Together, we can draw on our collective strength beneath the Celestus and, through it, restore the balance.

events.summary: Arlinn objects that gathering so many humans invites an attack.
events.quote: Putting that many humans in one place is begging for an attack.

events.summary: Katilda says the Moonsilver Key is needed to activate the Celestus.
events.quote: we need the Moonsilver Key to activate it

events.summary: Katilda warns that without the proper ritual the night will overtake the day.
events.quote: then the night will overtake the day

events.summary: A rough, deep howl interrupts them, and Arlinn recognizes it as Tovolar's.

relations.note: Streak is part of Arlinn's wolf pack.
relations.quote: He is the fastest of her pack.

relations.note: Katilda speaks as the leader of the coven.

relations.quote: her Finneas's blood paints the walls red

relations.note: They split long ago; each found a pack.
relations.quote: He found his pack, and she found hers.

relations.note: Arlinn was formerly an Avacynian priest.
relations.quote: As an Avacynian priest, Arlinn knew well how strong the Archangel's protection had been.
